column2: You know where the old foraging trails begin, west of Primeval Woods — years scouting these woods sharpened your eye for what's worth picking, granting a steady foraging bonus. An Overgrown Forest Trail waits at Primeval Woods: hack it clear with a blade to open the way in. Left untended it regrows in about ten days, so keep your blade sharp. A portal will always take you straight to the forest if the trail closes on you.
column3: 你知道古老觅食小径的起点，就在原初森林以西——多年在这片森林中侦察的经历练就了你识别可采集之物的眼力，带来稳定的觅食加成。原初森林处有一条杂草丛生的森林小径：用刀砍清即可开辟进入的道路。若放任不管，大约十天后会重新长满，所以要保持刀刃锋利。如果小径被堵，传送门总能带你直达森林。
